sections.section_content:
message authentication
The following figure shows a typical operation for authenticated encryption or decryption,
and for cipher-based message authentication.
[Figure 178. Typical operation with authentication]
Section27.4.11: AES Galois/counter mode (GCM) and Section27.4.13: AES counter with
CBC-MAC (CCM) describe detailed sequences supported by AES.
Cipher-based message authentication flow omits the payload phase, as shown in the figure.
Detailed sequence supported by AES is described in Section27.4.12: AES Galois message
authentication code (GMAC).
